title: 405 Method Not Allowed
description:
RFC 9110 §15.5.6; class client_error; engine use: conditional.
Trigger: The path exists but does not allow the request method.
Content: application/problem+json (ErrorEnvelope).
Required headers: Allow.
Cache-Control: no-store; retry: never.

x-response-contract.trigger: The path exists but does not allow the request method.

Allow.value: Comma-separated methods registered for the request target.
Allow.notes: Every method declared for the path MUST appear; HEAD is implied by GET.

examples.title: Method Not Allowed
examples.detail: The path exists but does not allow the request method.
